title: Before you go
autoNote: Saved automatically when you save the offline pack
toggleFailed: Couldn't save that change. Try again.

visa.title: Sort out your visa
visa.body: Check what you need to enter and apply before the deadline.

passport.title: Check your passport
passport.body: Make sure it is valid for at least six months after you return and has blank pages.

bookings.title: Book flights and hotel
bookings.body: Pick a flight and a place to stay in your plan.

insurance.title: Get travel insurance
insurance.body: Cover medical care, cancellations and lost bags.

documents.title: Gather your documents
documents.body: Tickets, confirmations, visa and insurance papers, in one place.

stress_test.title: Stress-test your itinerary
stress_test.body: Run the re-check to catch tight timings and clashes.

sim.title: Choose a SIM or eSIM
sim.body: Pick how you will get data when you land.

money.title: Sort out your money
money.body: Notify your bank, carry a backup card and a little local cash.

packing.title: Pack your bags
packing.body: Go through your packing list and tick things off.

emergency_card.title: Review your emergency card
emergency_card.body: Know the local emergency numbers and your embassy.

checkin.title: Check in online
checkin.body: Most airlines open online check-in about 24 hours before departure.

offline_pack.title: Save the offline pack
offline_pack.body: Keep your essentials on your phone for when you have no signal.
